title: Expressivity Results for Structured Argumentation Frameworks with Uncertain Rules and Premises
abstract: arXiv:2510.18631v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modelling qualitative uncertainty in formal argumentation is essential both for practical applications and theoretical understanding. Yet, most existing work focuses on abstract models of argumentation under uncertainty. Following a recent trend in the literature, we tackle the open question of studying plausible instantiations of these abstract models. To do so, we root the uncertainty of arguments in their components in structured models: rules and premises. Our main conceptual contribution is to provide an intuitive notion of comparative expressivity suitable for both abstract and structured formalisms. translated_title: 具有不确定规则与前提的结构化论证框架的表达能力研究结果
translated_abstract: 在形式化论证中对定性不确定性进行建模，对于实际应用和理论理解都至关重要。然而，现有工作大多聚焦于不确定性下论证的抽象模型。顺应文献中的最新趋势，我们着手解决研究这些抽象模型的合理实例化这一开放性问题。为此，我们在结构化模型中将论证的不确定性根植于其组成部分：规则与前提。我们的主要概念性贡献是提供了一个直观的比较表达能力概念，该概念同时适用于抽象形式体系和结构化形式体系。大致而言，如果一个处理定性不确定性论证的形式体系能够生成与另一个形式体系相同的抽象论证框架集合（即完备化），那么前者至少与后者具有同等的表达能力。在技术方面，我们证明了比较抽象模型与结构化模型表达能力的一系列负面和正面结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个同时适用于抽象与结构化论证形式体系的直观比较表达能力概念，通过将论证的不确定性根植于规则与前提层面，证明了此类结构化不确定性论证框架与抽象不确定性论证模型之间表达能力的正反两方面的比较结果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an intuitive notion of comparative expressivity for both abstract and structured argumentation formalisms, and by grounding argument uncertainty in rules and premises, proves positive and negative results comparing the expressivity of structured argumentation frameworks with uncertain rules and premises against abstract models of argumentation under uncertainty.
